item.title: Another round of snow tonight ahead of bitter cold
item.description: Light snow showers and flurries are expected to continue overnight and into Saturday morning, followed by a period of cold temperatures and gusty winds before warmer weather returns on Sunday.

item.title: Arctic cold grips the Ozarks before gradual warm-up
item.description: Temperatures are expected to be brutally cold tonight, with wind chills potentially dropping into the negatives, and an arctic air mass will reestablish itself on Monday, bringing temperatures in the 20s and wind chills in the single digits, before conditions begin to normalize on Tuesday.
